People: Inchbald (author, Wikidata Q469974), died 1821; Néricault Destouches (author, Wikidata Q177063), died 1754; Louis-Sébastien Mercier (author, Wikidata Q709670), died 1814. Printed edition: Next door neighbours; a comedy; in three acts. From the French dramas L'indigent & Le dissipateur. As performed at the Theatre-Royal, Hay-Market. By Mrs. Inchbald.  1791, 1791, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bim_eighteenth-century_next-door-neighbours-a-_inchbald-mrs_1791. The scan does not show the credit of Inchbald, Néricault Destouches, Louis-Sébastien Mercier, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
